results.name: PowerSeries
results.source_text:
/-- Formal power series over a coefficient type `R` -/
@[wikidata Q1003025]
abbrev PowerSeries (R : Type*) :=
  MvPowerSeries Unit R
results.docstring: Formal power series over a coefficient type `R`

results.name: Space.normPowerSeries
results.source_text:
/-- A power series which is differentiable everywhere, and in the limit
  as `n → ∞` tends to `‖x‖`. -/
def normPowerSeries {d} : ℕ → Space d → ℝ := fun n x =>
  √(‖x‖ ^ 2 + 1/(n + 1))
results.docstring:
A power series which is differentiable everywhere, and in the limit
as `n → ∞` tends to `‖x‖`.

results.name: Polynomial.degree_X_pow_le
results.source_text:
theorem degree_X_pow_le (n : ℕ) : degree (X ^ n : R[X]) ≤ n := by
  simpa only [C_1, one_mul] using degree_C_mul_X_pow_le n (1 : R)

results.name: Real.pow_le_iff_le_log
results.source_text:
lemma pow_le_iff_le_log (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) : x ^ n ≤ y ↔ n * log x ≤ log y := by
  rw [← rpow_le_iff_le_log hx hy, rpow_natCast]

results.docstring: `natDegree p` forces `degree p` to ℕ, by defining `natDegree 0 = 0`.

results.name: Nat.dist.triangle_inequality
results.source_text:
theorem dist.triangle_inequality (n m k : ℕ) : dist n k ≤ dist n m + dist m k := by
  unfold Nat.dist; lia

results.name: Nat.card_submonoidPowers
results.source_text:
/-- See also `orderOf_eq_card_powers`. -/
@[to_additive /-- See also `addOrder_eq_card_multiples`. -/]
lemma Nat.card_submonoidPowers : Nat.card (powers a) = orderOf a := by
  classical
  by_cases ha : IsOfFinOrder a
  · exact (Nat.card_congr (finEquivPowers ha).symm).trans <| by simp
  · have := (infinite_powers.2 ha).to_subtype
    rw [orderOf_eq_zero ha, Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite]

results.name: WithDim.instAddCommSemigroup
results.source_text:
instance (d : Dimension) (M : Type) [AddCommSemigroup M] :
    AddCommSemigroup (WithDim d M) where
  add_comm m1 m2 := by
    ext
    simp [add_comm]

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
